prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define the registry of Domain identities and their explicit Universal Module compositions, relation sets and domain-specific semantic deltas. [2] Define the Domain Registry as the explicit index of active Domain identities and their authoritative composition contracts, without absorbing Domain semantics.

references.purpose: Registry entries implement Domain composition semantics.
Domains own only their semantic delta.

semantics.authority_rule: Domain registration/visibility does not grant runtime authority.
semantics.closure_rule: Domain registry entry resolves all required substrate and delta refs.
semantics.composition_rule: Domain declares the Universal Module substrate refs it composes.
semantics.delta_rule: Domain declares only domain-specific relations, constraints, roles, operations, policies and behavior not already owned by substrates.
semantics.filesystem_rule: Directory presence alone does not register a Domain.
semantics.identity_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Domain identity is separate from every component module identity. [2] Domain identity resolves exactly to its authoritative Domain composition contract.
semantics.membership_rule: Only explicitly registered active Domains participate in registry-based discovery.
semantics.ownership_rule: Registry does not own or redefine Domain semantics.
semantics.projection_rule: Domain catalogs/maps are projections of the registry.
semantics.registry_rule: Every Domain has an explicit stable canonical identity.
semantics.reuse_rule: A Universal Module can be shared across Domains without semantic duplication.
